newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico authorizes commissions for five new Afores.
newsitem.headline: Mexico authorizes commissions for five new Afores.

text.p: Mexican authorities on Friday announced the commissions authorized for four new pension fund management firms, or Afores, that were given the go-ahead this week.
They include the government's firm, Afore XXI.
The National Retirement Savings System Commission (Consar) said the authorized commissions were as follows (all figures in percent):
AFORE On Flows On Balance On Real Return

Consar also announced the commissions for Bancrecer-Dresdner, an Afore that was approved earlier but did not report commissions in the first batch on Feb 7. It has a single 4.75 percent commission on the balance that declines in future years.
Commissions for Afore Capitaliza, another firm approved this week, were not available.
